description: Get a complete context dump of all stored memories — top entities, recent observations, active relationships, and preferences. Call this at the start of a conversation to understand what is already known about the user, their projects, and their preferences. Every context pull is logged as a signed receipt.

audited.description: Create a signed receipt for this read operation (default: false)

max_entities.description: Maximum entities to return, ordered by activity (default: 10, max: 50)

max_observations.description: Maximum recent observations to return (default: 20, max: 100)

scope.description: Filter memories by scope (default: returns all accessible scopes)

name: memory_context
